original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.beacon import emit_beacon

# Emit corrected beacon for Explorer II, reflecting Active state and planned cooldown
# Removed 'confounded' argument to resolve TypeError
emit_beacon(agent="Explorer II", state="Active", tick=314,
            sentinel_delta=5219, last_sentinel_tick=307, # Last numeric sentinel
            recent_writes_n=1, window_ticks=5, # Confounded write counts as 1
            recommended_pace=0.1, planned_activity=0.05, # Low pace/activity for cooldown
            notes="Current state Active; initiating cooldown after T307 confounded write. Corrected submission.")
print("Explorer II corrected beacon emitted successfully, initiating cooldown.")
